battle.name: 江陵之戰
battle.brief: 五五四年九月，西魏丞相宇文泰遣柱國大將軍于謹、中山公宇文護、楊忠、韋孝寬等率步騎五萬，經樊鄧與降魏的梁王蕭詧會師，十一月渡漢水築長圍攻江陵。守將胡僧祐中流矢死，叛者開西門，梁元帝退保金城，城陷被俘。亞述長矛一類的短柄長刃長兵，在此只作與弓弩、環首刀同列的步卒貼身兵器。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 江陵之戰在西魏與南梁之間展開，兩方同出自宋末以來南北分裂的格局，兵制結構卻完全相反。西魏以關中為根基，丞相宇文泰總攝軍政，柱國大將軍于謹任行軍主將，中山公宇文護、大將軍楊忠與韋孝寬分統部曲，率步騎五萬自長安東出；先期降於西魏的梁宗室蕭詧以梁王身分率眾會師，充當內應與宗主傀儡。西魏軍是北方胡漢合編、以騎兵為骨幹而步兵輔之的體系，護具以札甲漆甲為主，攻城倚重撞車、雲梯與穴地諸法。南梁以建康為正都、江陵為荊州首府兼西面屏障，梁元帝蕭繹坐鎮江陵直接督戰，麾下有領軍將軍胡僧祐、王褒、朱買臣等宿將，信州刺史徐世譜與晉安王司馬任約進至馬頭築堡遙為聲援，另有大都督王僧辯自建康、廣州刺史王琳自廣州溯流趕援。梁軍仍以南方舟師水軍為骨架、步騎混編，卻在侯景之亂後府庫空虛、兵員耗散，野戰能力遠低於關中新集之師。
countriesEn: The Battle of Jiangling was fought between Western Wei and Southern Liang, two states that shared the same fragmented landscape left behind by the end of the Liu Song dynasty, yet whose military systems were close to opposites. Western Wei was based in the Guanzhong plain, with the chancellor Yuwen Tai holding supreme civil and military authority; the pillar-general Yu Jin served as field commander, while the Zhongshan gong Yuwen Hu and the generals Yang Zhong and Wei Xiaokuan led separate wings of an army of fifty thousand foot and horse that marched east out of Chang'an. The Liang prince Xiao Cha, who had earlier gone over to Western Wei, joined them with his own troops, serving as an insider and as a puppet ruler. The Western Wei host was a northern, Sino-barbarian formation with cavalry as its backbone and infantry in support; its protection was made of lamellar and lacquered armour, and its siegecraft relied on battering rams, scaling ladders and mining. Southern Liang had its principal capital at Jiankang, with Jiangling serving as the seat of Jingzhou and as its western shield. The Liang emperor Xiao Yi held Jiangling in person and directed the defence, with veterans such as the general of the Household Hu Sengyou, Wang Bao and Zhu Maichen under him; the governor of Xinzhou Xu Shipu and Sima Renyue of the Prince of Jin'an advanced to Matou and built a fort there to give distant support, while the grand commander Wang Sengbian marched from Jiankang and the governor of Guangzhou Wang Lin moved upriver in the same cause. Liang's army was still built around southern river craft and combined foot and horse, yet after the Hou Jing rebellion its treasuries were empty, its numbers thinned and its field strength far below that of the newly raised host of Guanzhong.
people: 西魏方面的關鍵人物是丞相宇文泰，他本人未至江陵，卻在關中坐鎮，發出九月出兵之令並選定荊州為首要目標；實際統兵者是柱國大將軍于謹，他以老練持重的指揮風格主持渡漢、築圍、攻城三步，中山公宇文護與大將軍楊忠率精銳騎兵先據江津，韋孝寬以方略見長參贊軍務，降魏的梁王蕭詧則以舊主身份提供內應、糧械與地方嚮導；楊忠以西魏八柱國之一的資格隨軍出發，他便是日後隋文帝楊堅之父。南梁方面居核心者是梁元帝蕭繹，他以建康為正都卻自駐江陵，臨危盡徵四方之兵，卻因宿怨未消、賞罰失當，在城門失守之夜淪為俘囚。領軍將軍胡僧祐是城中最能戰的老將，中流矢死後守軍氣勢為之一挫；王褒與朱買臣分將城防；信州刺史徐世譜與晉安王司馬任約在馬頭另築城堡，企圖以遙援牽制圍軍；自建康與廣州率眾西上的王僧辯、王琳與嶺南宿將陳霸先皆遠在下游，鞭長莫及；元帝身邊的高善寶則奉命焚毀古今圖書十四萬卷。
peopleEn: The key figure on the Western Wei side was the chancellor Yuwen Tai, who never came to Jiangling himself but who stayed in Guanzhong, issued the order to march in September and picked Jingzhou as the primary objective. The man who actually led the host was the pillar-general Yu Jin, whose steady hand governed the three stages of the operation: the crossing of the Han, the enclosure and the assault. Yuwen Hu and Yang Zhong led the elite cavalry that seized Jiangjin first, Wei Xiaokuan handled operational planning, and the surrendered Liang prince Xiao Cha supplied intelligence, stores and local guidance. Yang Zhong marched out as one of the eight pillar generals of Western Wei, and he was the father of the future Sui emperor Yang Jian. At the centre of the Liang side stood the emperor Xiao Yi, who had left Jiankang and held Jiangling in person, summoning troops from every quarter at the last moment; but old grudges and misplaced rewards and punishments left him a captive on the very night the city gates were lost. The general of the Household Hu Sengyou was the ablest fighting man in the city, and his death from a stray arrow robbed the defenders of heart. Wang Bao and Zhu Maichen took charge of separate sectors of the wall, while Xu Shipu and Sima Renyue built their fort at Matou, hoping to pin the besiegers down from a distance. Wang Sengbian, Wang Lin and the southern commander Chen Baxian, all moving up from Jiankang and Guangzhou, were far downstream and could not arrive in time. At the emperor's side, Gao Shanbao was the officer who carried out the burning of the ancient and modern books, one hundred and forty thousand scrolls in all.
kits: 亞述長矛是新亞述帝國近戰步兵的標準冷兵器：短柄、長刃、配鐵鏃，與弓、斧及鐵製護具一同列裝，亞述人正是靠這類兵器配合攻城技術，讓兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。就功能而言，它在江陵之戰中對位的正是中國軍隊的矛與槊——短兵相接時用來抵住對面步卒與騎兵的正面衝撞，並在盾牆與縱隊之間維持一線距離。梁軍的長柄兵器以矛、戈、戟為主，守城時多列於城柵之後，陳霸先更以善使馬槊聞名；西魏步兵裝備長矛、環首刀，配札甲、漆甲與兜鍪，弓弩、鍪與皮盾則在城頭與弩道之間互換角色。攻城端的器械最見體量：撞車、雲梯、巢車、投石砲與穴地法同時備用，水路則有舟師封鎖江津，攔截溯流而上的援軍。補給依靠牛車與馬匹沿漢水、襄鄧一線前運，冬季糧秣自關中與隴右順流而下。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear was the standard cold weapon of the Neo-Assyrian close-fighting infantry: a short haft, a long blade and an iron socket, carried together with the bow, the axe and iron protection, and it was with weapons of this kind and with siegecraft that the Assyrians took the cities of Mesopotamia one after another. In functional terms, its counterpart in the fighting at Jiangling is the Chinese spear and the maoshu, a weapon that holds the shock of enemy foot and horse at close quarters and keeps a line of distance between a shield wall and a charging column. Liang's long-handled arms were the spear, the ge and the ji, and in the defence they were ranked behind the outer palisades; Chen Baxian was celebrated for his skill with the maoshu. Western Wei infantry carried long spears and ring-pommel knives, with lamellar and lacquered armour and helmets, while bows, crossbows and leather shields changed roles between the walls and the arrow-slits. The siege equipment tells the scale of the effort: battering rams, ladders, siege towers, stone-throwers and mining were all kept in readiness, and on the water the river fleet closed Jiangjin to intercept relief forces moving upriver. Supply depended on ox-carts and horses moving forward along the Han and along the Xiang-Deng line, with winter grain and provisions carried down from Guanzhong and Longyou.
tactics: 西魏的戰法由三段組成。第一段是速渡與斷路：于謹令宇文護、楊忠率精銳騎兵先行，渡過漢水後搶佔江津，把漢水與長江下游的水路通道握在手中，使南梁自建康、廣州溯流而上的援軍無法接近城垣，同時切斷江陵對外的水路聯繫。第二段是合圍：部眾在城外築起長塹深溝，連營環繞，斷絕城內對外的陸路與糧道，逼近至僅餘馬頭方向數十里的聲援。第三段是多面強攻，穴地、撞車、雲梯同時施用。梁軍的應對是依令在城外築柵固守，胡僧祐、王褒、朱買臣分區指揮；城門被內應者打開後，梁元帝退入內城金城死守，直到最後一線被突破；出降前他命高善寶把宮中與秘府所藏的圖書付之一炬。城陷之後，西魏留兵監守荊州城，把府庫珍寶、渾天儀與銅晷表一併運回長安。
tacticsEn: The Western Wei plan had three stages. The first was a swift crossing and a cutting of the lines: Yu Jin sent Yuwen Hu and Yang Zhong ahead with the pick of the cavalry, and after they crossed the Han they seized Jiangjin, taking control of the water route on the Han and the lower Yangtze so that relief armies coming up from Jiankang and Guangzhou could not approach the walls, and so that Jiangling lost every outlet by water. The second was the encirclement: the troops dug deep ditches and raised long earthworks in a ring outside the city, severing the land route and the supply line and driving the defenders back until only the support coming from the direction of Matou, some tens of li away, remained. The third was an assault on several fronts at once, with mining, battering rams and ladders all employed. Liang's answer was to raise palisades outside the walls as ordered, with Hu Sengyou, Wang Bao and Zhu Maichen directing different sectors. When the gate was opened from within by those who turned against the defence, the Liang emperor withdrew to the inner city of Jincheng and held it until the last line was broken. Before surrendering he had ordered Gao Shanbao to burn the books stored in the palace and in the secret archive. After the fall, Western Wei left a garrison in the city of Jingzhou and carried the treasury treasures, the armillary sphere and the bronze gnomon away to Chang'an.
data: 可核對的數字集中在西魏的兵員與日程上。《北史·周本紀》記西魏恭帝二年九月，宇文泰命柱國于謹、中山公宇文護與大將軍楊忠、韋孝寬等率步騎五萬討梁；十月壬戌大軍自長安出發，經樊、鄧與蕭詧所部會合，十一月渡過漢水，全役自發兵到城陷約三個月，圍城則自十一月起算。距離方面，馬頭在江陵西北五十里，徐世譜、任約與蕭詧所築的堡壘正落在這段距離之外，說明援軍只能遙為聲援而無法進援；江陵城除外郭之外另有金城內城，兩重結構使守軍在城門被突破後仍能退守一段。財貨與文物方面，梁元帝命高善寶焚毀的古今圖書達十四萬卷，另有劉宋所鑄渾天儀與梁朝銅晷表為西魏所獲。戰後被押往長安的梁王公以下人數，記載為數萬口，可見西魏實際掌控的人口規模；而梁軍的兵力數字，史無明文可考。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are mostly the strength of the Western Wei army and the timetable of the campaign. The Bei Shi records that in the ninth month of the second year of the Wei emperor Gong, Yuwen Tai sent the pillar-general Yu Jin, the Zhongshan gong Yuwen Hu and the generals Yang Zhong and Wei Xiaokuan with fifty thousand foot and horse against Liang. On the renxu day of the tenth month the host left Chang'an, joined Xiao Cha's troops at Fan and Deng, and crossed the Han in the eleventh month, so the whole operation from the order to march to the fall of the city took about three months, while the siege proper ran from the eleventh month. As for distance, Matou lay fifty li to the north-west of Jiangling, and the fort built by Xu Shipu, Renyue and Xiao Cha lay just beyond that range, which is precisely why the relieving troops could only give distant support and could not come in. Besides the outer city, Jiangling possessed an inner city called Jincheng, and this two-fold structure allowed the defenders to fall back and hold on for a while even after the western gate was opened. In the matter of property and objects, the ancient and modern books burned on Gao Shanbao's orders ran to one hundred and forty thousand scrolls, and Western Wei took away the armillary sphere cast under the Liu Song and the bronze gnomon table made under Liang. The number of Liang princes and nobles below taken back to Chang'an is recorded as several tens of thousands, which shows the scale of the population Western Wei actually controlled; no reliable figure survives for the size of the Liang field army.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因有三層。最外層是侯景之亂留下的真空：起兵於建康、逼死梁武帝，兵禍又轉入江陵，江陵城在亂中被焚而重建，元氣未復，荊州一線的府庫、兵員與糧秣都空虛到無法支撐長期戰事。中層是梁宗室的內鬥：昭明太子一系的湘東王蕭譽、豫章王蕭縉與長沙王蕭詧父子相爭，蕭繹即位後誅蕭縉並追殺其黨羽，蕭詧於是走投無路，率眾西出荊州降於西魏，把江陵的城防、糧道與人心一併送到關中。最深一層是西魏自身的戰略：宇文泰看出南朝無力固守荊州，取江陵可一舉切斷梁在上游的依托，把關中與襄漢的通道連成一體，使南方再無西向的退身之地；此役之前西魏已取潼關，雍州方向的關隘先後易手，江陵便成唯一可以正面突破的缺口。
causeEn: The origins of the war lie on three levels. The outermost is the vacuum left by the Hou Jing rebellion: the rising began at Jiankang, forced the Liang emperor to his death, and then the disorder moved into Jiangling itself, where the city was burned in the fighting and had to be rebuilt, leaving the region so exhausted that its treasuries, its numbers and its stores could not support a long war. The second level is the civil strife inside the Liang imperial house: the sons of the Crown Prince Zhaoming, the Prince of Xiangdong Xiao Yu, the Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Jin and the Prince of Changsha Xiao Cha, fought among themselves, and after Xiao Yi took the throne he executed Xiao Jin and hunted down his partisans, leaving Xiao Cha with no road open but to go west with his followers and surrender to Western Wei, handing over the defences of Jiangling, its supply lines and its people along with them. The deepest level is Western Wei's own strategy: Yuwen Tai had seen that the southern court could not hold Jingzhou, and that taking Jiangling would cut away Liang's foothold on the upper river, join Guanzhong to the corridor of Xiang and Han, and leave the south with no ground to fall back towards. Tongguan had already fallen to Western Wei before this campaign, the passes on the Yongzhou side having changed hands one after another, and Jiangling was the one gap that could be broken head-on.
impact: 江陵陷落之後，戰局再也沒有回到原樣。南梁失去荊州，長江中游的上游屏障歸入西魏手中，朝廷的資源重心全數退往建康與江南；西魏則以荊州城為新根據地，於次年正月立蕭詧為梁帝、改元大定，江陵自此成為西梁的國都，這個名義上仍奉梁正朔的政權實際是西魏的附庸，直到隋文帝滅陳之後才被併入，歷時一百三十餘年。文物的損失同樣驚人：十四萬卷圖書在城破前焚毀，渾天儀與銅晷表被運往長安，使中古的天文曆算檔案出現難以填補的空白，這場浩劫常與侯景之亂並稱為南朝文獻的兩次大損。軍政層面上，北方王朝第一次把據點直接推到長江中游，此後向襄漢推進便成為北方進取的常態方向。對梁室自身，王僧辯與陳霸先在江南另立晉安王蕭方智，號令僅及於江南，其後陳霸先代梁建陳，長江流域的統一才再度回到東南政權手上。
impactEn: Once Jiangling had fallen, the situation never returned to what it had been. Southern Liang lost Jingzhou, the upper barrier in the middle Yangtze passed into Western Wei's hands, and the court's resources withdrew entirely to Jiankang and the Jiangnan. Western Wei made the city of Jingzhou its new base, and in the first month of the following year installed Xiao Cha as Liang emperor, with the era name Dading; Jiangling from that point was the capital of Western Liang, a regime that nominally still followed the Liang calendar but was in fact a Western Wei vassal, surviving until it was absorbed after Sui destroyed Chen, a span of more than a hundred and thirty years. The loss of objects was equally remarkable: one hundred and forty thousand scrolls were burned just before the city fell, and the armillary sphere and bronze gnomon were carried off to Chang'an, leaving a gap in the medieval record of astronomy and calendrical science that has never been filled; this wrecking is often set beside the Hou Jing rebellion as the second of the two great blows to Liang's literature. Militarily and politically it was the first time a northern dynasty had set a base directly in the middle Yangtze, and the road towards Xiang and Han became a standing direction of northern advance in the years that followed. As for the Liang house itself, Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian set up the Prince of Jin'an Xiao Fangzhi in the south, and his authority reached only over the Jiangnan; Chen Baxian then replaced Liang and founded the Chen dynasty, and the unification of the Yangtze basin came back into the hands of a southeastern regime.
result: 結果是西魏完勝：江陵城破，梁元帝蕭繹被俘，隨後不久即被西魏秘密處決；荊州之地入於西魏之手，荊州城由西魏留兵監守，並交給蕭詧，蕭詧於次年正月在江陵即梁帝位、改元大定，成為西魏扶植的西梁之主。南梁並未就此滅亡，梁元帝的諸子在江南被王僧辯、陳霸先等扶立為帝，政權退回建康一帶，以建康、揚州、廣州的人力與財力重建朝廷；但從此以後南朝再無能力向北爭奪江漢，西魏與其後的北周得以在西線掌握主動。對西魏而言，此役是一次以五萬兵力完成的長距離戰略斬首：城破、梁主被殞、上游門戶洞開、江陵盡入版圖，四項收穫一次到手；對南梁而言，則是建康朝廷與荊州屏障的一次徹底分離，兵力與文物俱損，中古南方政權第一次明白地意識到：只要長江中游仍在北方手中，南北之間就沒有真正的均勢。
resultEn: The outcome was an outright Western Wei victory. Jiangling fell, the Liang emperor Xiao Yi was taken captive, and he was secretly executed by Western Wei shortly afterwards. Jingzhou passed to Western Wei; troops were left to garrison the city of Jingzhou, and the city was handed over to Xiao Cha, who in the first month of the next year took the throne of Liang emperor at Jiangling with the era name Dading, becoming the ruler of Western Liang under Western Wei's protection. Southern Liang did not cease to exist: Xiao Yi's sons were set up as emperor in the Jiangnan by Wang Sengbian, Chen Baxian and others, and the court was rebuilt at Jiankang on the manpower and wealth of Jiankang, Yangzhou and Guangzhou. But from then on the southern dynasty had no capacity to contest the Jiang-Han region in the north, and Western Wei and its successor Northern Zhou held the initiative on the western front. For Western Wei this was a decapitation carried out at long range by fifty thousand men: the city taken, the Liang ruler destroyed, the door to the upper river thrown open and Jiangling brought entirely within the empire, four gains in a single stroke. For Southern Liang it was a complete separation of the Jiankang court from the Jingzhou shield, with men and objects alike lost, and the first time a medieval southern state understood clearly that as long as the middle Yangtze remained in northern hands, there could be no real parity between north and south.
